paragraphs: ICST – Your Geothermal Cooling Tower Parts Resource
ICST specializes in the design, repair, and upgrade of cooling towers for the Geothermal Power Industry worldwide.
ICST designs custom cooling solutions with a focus on technology and customer support, providing performance and cost-effective cooling service.
ICST has the experience and expertise to repair or upgrade your water cooling tower for maximum performance with minimum downtime.
